newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms show Jan-Nov PLN 9.5 bln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms show Jan-Nov PLN 9.5 bln net profit.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 9.5 billion zloty ($3.27 billion) net profit in the January-November 1996 period, flat against the same period in 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GUS said the private sector made a net profit of 5.9 billion zlotys on total revenues of 241.9 billion in the period versus a 3.6 billion in profits and 160.2 billion in sales a year ago.
The state-owned sector reported a 3.7 billion-profit on sales of 243.2 billion versus last year's 5.9 billion and 213.5 billion, respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
